note: mypy 1.19.1 -> 2.3.0: 1297 -> 1293. Measured the way py_typecheck.yml measures -- a venv holding only mypy==2.3.0, run from a clean worktree at 6c2327edf33 with --no-incremental and the six -p packages. The -4 understates the churn: 19 findings disappear and 17 appear. Most of both are the SAME defect reworded, so they must not be read as fixes or regressions -- "Incompatible default for argument" became "... for parameter" (grouping.py, read_group/mixin.py), IO[bytes] became IO[Any] (four in service/db/dump.py), list[Never] became list[Any] (traversal.py), and one2many.py:239 moved from "Keywords must be strings" [misc] to "Argument after ** must have string keys" [arg-type]. Genuinely retired: the three dateutil import-untyped errors (constants.py, date_utils.py) that the previous note flagged as the warm-cache discrepancy -- 2.3.0 no longer reports them at all, which removes that trap rather than documenting it; plus isdisjoint in libs/collections/misc.py, three in orm/models/mixins/iteration.py, and one each in load.py, translation.py and one2many.py. Genuinely NEW, and worth reading as findings rather than noise: four in orm/models/mixins/read_group/format.py:147-182 ("date" has no attribute "astimezone"; unexpected keyword "tzinfo" for "replace" of "date"; a str assigned to a date), which look like a real date/datetime confusion this gate could not see before; one in orm/fields/textual.py:815; and one in service/model.py:63 returning Callable|None where Callable is declared. The two psycopg Loader [override] errors in db/utils.py appear only WITH the project dependencies installed, so they stay invisible to CI in either version. No mypy.ini change was needed; the [mypy-odoo.tools.embedded_sass_pb2] section is reported unused by both versions and predates this bump.
